## Problem and change / 问题与改动

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue when relevant.
说明具体问题和改变后的行为，可关联 Issue。

## Verification / 验证

List relevant checks performed and remaining scope. Include Android/device/backend when device behavior changes.
列出相关检查和未覆盖范围；设备行为改动请注明 Android、机型与后端。

## UI or compatibility impact / 界面或兼容影响

For UI changes, attach real, sanitized screenshots approved for public use when available. For protocol or dependency changes, explain compatibility and source/license updates.
UI 改动可附经同意公开的真实脱敏截图；协议或依赖改动说明兼容和来源/许可更新。

Keep credentials, keys, personal data and runtime logs out of this PR.
请勿包含凭据、密钥、个人数据或运行日志。
